CHAPTER 4 · ITEM 01 / 10

Demand and supply

Demand and supply laws供需法則

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Define quantity demanded and quantity supplied; explain the laws of demand and supply, holding other influences constant.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

需求量是買家在某價願意及能夠購買的數量；供給量是賣家願意及能夠出售的數量。其他因素不變時，價格升令 Qd 降、Qs 升。

Quantity demanded is how much buyers are willing and able to buy at a given price; quantity supplied is what sellers are willing and able to sell. Holding other factors constant, higher price lowers Qd and raises Qs.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：At $5 buyers want 20 units; at $6 they want 16. This is a downward relationship between price and quantity demanded. 價格上升令需求量下降。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Holding other factors fixed, a higher price usually does what? 其他不變，價格上升？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
